rules.key: you must include a Fleet Commander to lead the fleet
rules.text: If the fleet is above 750 points you must include a Fleet Commander to lead the fleet.
rules.why: The commander rows are in the section 0-1 Inquisitor Lord (RULE_PICKS points the rule at it).

rules.key: They must be aboard an Inquisitorial Cruiser if one is included
rules.text: They must be aboard an Inquisitorial Cruiser if one is included, otherwise they must be on an Inquisition Blackship if one is included.
rules.why: A placement rule (J215): the Aboard menu prefers these ships.

rules.key: A second re-roll can be purchased for +25 points
rules.text: A second re-roll can be purchased for +25 points.
rules.why: The row 'One extra re-roll' (25 pts), attached to both Inquisitor Lord rows.

rules.key: Can only be included, if the rest of the fleet is at least worth 1000 points
rules.text: Can only be included, if the rest of the fleet is at least worth 1000 points and an Ordo Malleus Inquisitor Lord leads the fleet.
rules.why: allowed_at with basis remainder and the Ordo Malleus Inquisitor Lord as its condition.

rules.key: This is a special vessel and does not count toward or against other ship limits
rules.text: This is a special vessel and does not count toward or against other ship limits in the fleet.
rules.why: The Blackship; the list has no other ship limits it could count against.

rules.key: For every 500 points of the fleet, or part thereof, one Grey Knights Strike Cruiser
rules.text: For every 500 points of the fleet, or part thereof, one Grey Knights Strike Cruiser may be included in the fleet.
rules.why: per_points 1 per 500; 'or part thereof' rounds up.

rules.key: escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2
rules.text: You may include any number of escorts in your fleet in squadrons of 2–6

rules.key: The vessel embarking the Inquisitor Lord or one Grey Knights vessel may board
rules.text: The vessel embarking the Inquisitor Lord or one Grey Knights vessel may board a Grey Knights terminator boarding party.
rules.why: The Terminators row has mx=1 (ENTRY_LIMITS) and is offered to capital ships (as in v0.36).

rules.key: Every Grey Knights vessel in the fleet may embark an Honour Guard
rules.text: Every Grey Knights vessel in the fleet may embark an Honour Guard.
rules.why: The Honour Guard row is offered to the Grey Knights capital ships, not the Blackship or the Inquisitorial Cruiser (ROW_CONDS, kept from v0.36).

rules.key: every Grey Knights vessel in the fleet mounts hexagrammic wards
rules.text: The vessel embarking the Inquisitor Lord and every Grey Knights vessel in the fleet mounts hexagrammic wards throughout its hull and ignores any Chaos marks or Daemonship effects affecting leadership or boarding actions.
rules.why: A rule of play on the cards.

rules.key: The enemy Chaos fleet may add one Mark of Chaos or upgrade a cruiser to a Daemonship
rules.text: The enemy Chaos fleet may add one Mark of Chaos or upgrade a cruiser to a Daemonship at no cost, and may also do so again as many times as there are Grey Knights strike cruisers in the fleet.
rules.why: Shown as the opponent's extras (L.opp, needs the Ordo Malleus Lord).

rules.key: A Grey Knights fleet has an attack rating of 3 unless a Blackship
rules.text: A Grey Knights fleet has an attack rating of 3 unless a Blackship is accompanying the fleet, in which case its attack rating is 2.

rules.key: will not take ships from or provide ships to any other fleet list
rules.text: A Grey Knights fleet will not take ships from or provide ships to any other fleet list as reserves or allies, including Imperial Navy, Rogue Trader or Adeptus Mechanicus fleet lists.
rules.why: 1.1 (14.9.2026): the same ban as for the Crusade (res_ban). The Grey Knights are not in p.14's race list, so the race gate would already prevent most of it, but the ban gives the right reason and also covers giving.

extra_entries.name: One extra re-roll
extra_entries.why: p.154, in the book only in the body text

notes: This list was separated from the Inquisition on 7.9.2026. On page 154 the book has its own heading 'GREY KNIGHTS FLEET LIST' and under it its own FLEET COMMANDER, CAPITAL SHIPS, ESCORTS and ATTACK RATING sections. Before the separation they showed as duplicates under the Inquisition.

The separation revealed three hidden dependencies, all tied to the list's NAME: two injections in upgrades.py, two FIXES corrections in build_data.py and one test in test_validator.js. All were fixed to point at the Grey Knights.

On page 155 the book writes the escorts' page references wrong: 'Rapid strike vessel (Sword) (pg. 104) (pg. 80)' - page 80 is the Falchion and page 82 is the Sword. FIXES corrects these to pages 82 and 84. The same error also concerns the rules page: the book says 104, the right one is 106.
The Grey Knights Strike Cruiser's price is unreadable in the book ('vvv'). It was added by hand at page 148's price of 165 pts.

Updated for Fleets v0.40 on 29.10.2026: the list was rewritten: a 0-1 Inquisitor Lord section with the Ordo Malleus Lord as a row of its own (100 pts), the Battle barge only with him, strike cruisers per 500 points or part thereof, a Firestorm row; the Sword and Cobra page misprints are gone.
